title: MOSOKO_German_Guten_Tag_65733d9d
style: Educational pop with funk and disco influences. Features a bright, clean electric guitar playing syncopated 16th-note scratches and rhythmic chords. A slap bass guitar follows the kick drum pattern with percussive pops. The drum kit maintains a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and tight hi-hats. Male lead vocals are clear and forward in the mix, supported by layered group backing vocals in the chorus. Occasional synth brass stabs and a subtle organ pad provide harmonic depth. Key of G major, 115 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar scratches, slap bass, steady drum beat]

[Verse 1]
[male lead vocals]
Guten Tag
That's where it starts
One word
Open every heart
Guten Tag, hello in German
Danke schön, thank you certain
Bitte, please with care
Auf Wiedersehen, see you there

[Chorus]
[group backing vocals join]
Guten Tag (Guten Tag)
Wie geht es Ihnen? (How are you?)
Freut mich (Nice to meet you)
Bis bald (See you soon)
Mozocó, learn a new tune
[vocal ad-lib] (Ooh)

[Verse 2]
[bass continues with slap technique]
Entschuldigung, sorry friend
Kein Problem, no problem blend
Wo ist? Where is it?
Wasser, Toilette, basics visit
[vocal ad-lib] (Ooh)

[Outro]
[synth brass stabs]
Guten Tag, danke, bitte, auf Wiedersehen
[final drum hit]
